title: malus toringo var. integrifolia
intro:
Malus toringo var. integrifolia, commonly known as the Chinese Crabapple, is a plant species that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant is used in traditional Chinese medicine, where it is valued for its health benefits, including the relief of fever, cough, and sore throat. The therapeutic actions of Malus toringo var. integrifolia include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
